## Purpose

Explain the user problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Scope

List the exact files and behavior changed.

## Privacy and security impact

Describe any effect on collection scope, consent, provider exposure, filesystem trust, credentials, retention, deletion, or validation. Write `None` only after checking each category.

## Verification

List the exact tests and disposable runtime routes executed. Include counts and operating systems when available.

## Checklist

1. [ ] No credentials, personal information, private conversation content, runtime Journal data, or local configuration is included.
2. [ ] New behavior has regression coverage.
3. [ ] Existing release and privacy checks pass.
4. [ ] Documentation and compatibility claims match verified behavior.
5. [ ] The change preserves fail closed validation and explicit approval boundaries.
